assign.request: Study the scale/gap/flow systems and collapse them into a small standard - the hypothesis is one --size knob (.size-small { --size: .75em }) with pad, gap and flow scaling fluidly with width, clamped; % first, container units if they earn it. Write the candidate as a :root block of <=8 lines, apply it via probe over the 20 audit pages at 400/1280/1920/3440, build the study page /imagine/design/size/, and give the verdict.
steps: Read the brief, the 09-05 spacing decision, framework.css :root, Page.css cqi pads
Write the candidate :root block (<=8 lines) and say what each token becomes
Build the probe: inject the candidate over the audit pages at 4 widths
Run before/after and collect medians for pad, gap, flow, body size
Build /imagine/design/size/ - candidate shown, live resize demo from ext/grip, table, verdict
Register the page in /imagine/design/page.js children and verify it loads
Grep the rule counts that would change if it lands

log.msg: mastermind call received mid-study: exactly ONE thing ramps type with width (the root font-size clamp); --size is a per-box unitless multiplier (.75/1/1.25), never width-driven; pad/gap/flow = --size x a container-width term (cqi where the box is a container, % otherwise), clamped; display type MAY take cqi as the one exception. Candidate rewritten to match; adding a compound test.

assign.now: probing the candidate over 20 pages at 4 widths

log.msg: VERDICT: one knob yes, one ramp no. The candidate (--size unitless x three clamps) measures identically to today at 400 and 1280 over the 20 audit pages and within 6% at 3440 (gap 22.1 -> 20.8px, the vw->cqi swap). The pure one-ramp collapse is refuted: rhythm at 1280 falls 28.8 -> 13.5px and at 400 25.2 -> 10.1px, because pad grows 5.0x across 400-3440 while rhythm grows 1.9x and no pair of constants is both.

--size must be UNITLESS, not the literal .75em: an em length can only move a clamp's floor and cap, never its fluid middle, so at 1280 the em form changes rhythm by 0% and gap by 2% while the unitless form changes both by 25%. Measured on 5 pages.

Compound test at 3440, three containers deep (960/550/308px): reading text 18/18/18px under the candidate, 18/17.5/12px if type took cqi. Type stays viewport-only; display type is the one cqi exception. Padding follows each box: 21.8/18/18px.

Two behaviour changes hide in the rename. (1) 650 component gaps are written calc(var(--gap-ramp) * N) - the UN-levelled token - so spacing-tight/airy do not reach them today: at 3440 spacing-tight leaves the median gap at 25.3px, exactly where regular leaves it. Under the candidate size-small moves it to 19.0px. A fix, but it moves real pixels. (2) vw -> cqi in the gap and rhythm ramps is identical on a plain page and container-aware inside a column, frame or rail.

The columns host is not a fourth system: measured on the same page at the same moment, --page-column-pad-x reads 15.4/32.4px at 1280/3440 and the candidate's --pad reads 15.0/32.8px in the same box - within 2.6% and 1.2%. Its pad-y is not a constant fraction of pad-x (0.68 at 1280, 0.50 at 3440), so it keeps its own line.

Cost if it lands: 945 renames by grep (829 ramp names, 103 default names, 6 --spacing reads, 7 level classes) plus 18 column-token sites rewritten. Keeping the old names as aliases is 3 lines and 0 edits, but leaves six names where three would do.
Skipped the ai/usage.json refresh - the brief's write fence excludes it. Usage at open was 8% of the 5h window, 32% of the 7d.

Verified headless at 400/1280/3440: no page errors, no horizontal overflow, the drag moves pad/gap/rhythm and never the reading text (13.5px through every gesture), the three chips move all three, the parent wall renders the new shot. Private server on :8099, pid 48760, killed at landing.
